<details class="details">
<summary>Technical Project Brief: Revilo Property Group</summary><div data-type="detailsContent"><h2><strong>1. Project Objective</strong></h2><p>Build a production-grade internal web application to replace fragmented workflows (AppFolio, Google Sheets, Asana) with a unified system for managing real estate projects, investors, and portfolio-level financial insights.</p><p><strong>Goal:</strong> </p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Automate interest accruals, equity/leverage tracking, and investor distribution/reallocation workflows.</p></li></ul><p><strong>Client Wishlist:</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>See which investors are in which projects easily</p></li><li><p>See dashboard overview of the entire group and breakdown by company</p></li><li><p></p></li></ul><hr><h2><strong>2. User Journey</strong></h2><ol class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Onboarding</strong>: Admin logs in and configures baseline entities (Companies, Lenders, Contractors, Realtors, Title Companies) in the <strong>Config</strong> section.</p></li><li><p><strong>Project Creation</strong>: Finance/Ops staff adds a new project in the <strong>Project Board</strong>, capturing purchase details, budget, and estimated ARV.</p></li><li><p><strong>Investor Allocation</strong>: Admin adds an investor, specifying the funding source and allocating capital across one or more active projects.</p></li><li><p><strong>Monitoring</strong>: Management uses the <strong>Dashboard</strong> to view real-time portfolio health (Scorecards for Total ARV, Equity, and Leverage %).</p></li><li><p><strong>Monthly Operations</strong>: Finance uses the <strong>Monthly Distribution</strong> report to track interest due and mark payments as paid (triggering accrual resets).</p></li><li><p><strong>Project Exit</strong>: When a project status changes to "Sold," the <strong>Sold Property Workflow</strong> is triggered to distribute or reallocate investor funds.</p></li></ol><hr><h2><strong>3. Data Model &amp; Transactional Ledger</strong></h2><pre><code class="language-mermaid">erDiagram
    COMPANY ||--o{ PROJECT : "owns"
    LENDER ||--o{ PROJECT : "finances"
    PROJECT ||--o{ ALLOCATION : "contains"
    INVESTOR ||--o{ ALLOCATION : "owns"
    
    ALLOCATION ||--o{ TRANSACTION : "records"
    
    PROJECT {
        uuid id PK
        string address
        enum status "ACTIVE, SOLD, RENTAL, etc."
        decimal arv
        decimal mortgage_balance
        date purchase_date
        date sale_date
    }

    INVESTOR {
        uuid id PK
        string name
        string email
        string phone
    }

    ALLOCATION {
        uuid id PK
        uuid investor_id FK
        uuid project_id FK
        decimal principal_amount
        decimal interest_rate
        enum type "MONTHLY, COMPOUNDED, PROFIT_SPLIT"
        date start_date
        date maturity_date
        boolean is_active
    }

    TRANSACTION {
        uuid id PK
        uuid allocation_id FK
        enum type "INTEREST_ACCRUAL, INTEREST_PAYOUT, PRINCIPAL_PAYOUT, REALLOCATION_IN, REALLOCATION_OUT"
        decimal amount
        date effective_date
        string reference_project_id "For reallocations"
        string description
    }
</code></pre><p>The system utilizes a <strong>Transactional Ledger</strong> approach to handle financial data. Every movement of money (accruals, payouts, reallocations) is recorded as a unique transaction, ensuring a 100% audit trail for the future Investor Portal.</p><h3><strong>3.1 Core Entities</strong></h3><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Project</strong>: Tracks property lifecycle, ARV, and debt.</p></li><li><p><strong>Investor</strong>: Personal profile and contact information.</p></li><li><p><strong>Allocation</strong>: The contract linking an Investor to a Project. Defines rate and terms.</p></li><li><p><strong>Transaction</strong>: The ledger entries that define the current balance.</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><em>Types</em>: <code>INTEREST_ACCRUAL</code>, <code>INTEREST_PAYOUT</code>, <code>PRINCIPAL_PAYOUT</code>, <code>REALLOCATION_IN</code>, <code>REALLOCATION_OUT</code>.</p></li></ul></li></ul><h3><strong>3.2 Audit Trail &amp; Investor Journey</strong></h3><p>To support the "Investor Journey" report:</p><ol class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Point-in-Time Reporting</strong>: Balances are calculated by summing transactions up to a specific date.</p></li><li><p><strong>Reallocation Linking</strong>: A <code>REALLOCATION_OUT</code> record on a closed project is linked via metadata to the <code>REALLOCATION_IN</code> record on the new project, allowing the UI to show a "Follow the money" breadcrumb.</p></li><li><p><strong>Daily Accruals</strong>: A background task generates daily interest records, allowing the system to show daily growth in the portal.</p></li></ol><hr><h2><strong>4. Navigation &amp; Page Structure</strong></h2><p>The app features a <strong>collapsible sidebar</strong> with an active user card (Avatar, Email, Logout).</p><h3><strong>Navigation Links</strong></h3><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Dashboard</strong> (Home)</p></li><li><p><strong>Portfolio Management</strong> (Group)</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Project Board</strong> (Consolidated view of all projects + Lifecycle tabs)</p></li><li><p><strong>Investors</strong> (List of investors + Total positions)</p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Financial Reports</strong> (Group)</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Monthly Distributions</strong> (Payout tracker)</p></li><li><p><strong>Note Expirations</strong> (Maturity tracking + Calendar)</p></li><li><p><strong>Newsletter Tracker</strong> (Exportable mailing list)</p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Settings</strong> (Group)</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Configuration</strong> (Lenders, Contractors, Agents, etc.)</p></li><li><p><strong>User Management</strong> (Admin only)</p></li></ul></li></ul><hr><h2><strong>5. Proposed Page Features &amp; UI Optimization</strong></h2><h3><strong>5.1 Dashboard (Portfolio Insights &amp; Decision Support)</strong></h3><p>The dashboard is designed for high-level management to identify risks, monitor liquidity, and track portfolio performance in real-time.</p><h4><strong>A. Executive Scorecards (The "Health" Layer)</strong></h4><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Live Projects</strong>: Number of live projects</p></li><li><p><strong>Total Portfolio ARV</strong>: Cumulative After-Repair Value of all active projects.</p></li><li><p><strong>Total Mortgages</strong>: Sum of all mortgages</p></li><li><p><strong>Total Investment Current Value</strong>: Sum of all principal + accrual</p></li><li><p><strong>Net Equity Position &amp; Equity %</strong>: <code>Total ARV − (Total Mortgages + Total Investor Debt + Estimated Closing Costs)</code>.</p></li><li><p><strong>Weighted Average Leverage %</strong>: Portfolio-wide leverage weighted by property value.</p></li><li><p><strong>Current Payout Liability</strong>: Sum of all <code>Accrued Interest</code> due on the 1st of the next month.</p></li><li><p><strong>Note Maturity Velocity</strong>: Number of notes maturing in the next 60 days.</p></li></ul><h4><strong>B. Critical Alerts Section (The "Risk" Layer)</strong></h4><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>⚠️ <strong>Negative Equity Alert</strong>: Projects where <code>Leverage % &gt; 95%</code>.</p></li><li><p>⚠️ <strong>Note Expiration Critical</strong>: Notes expiring in &lt; 15 days with no reallocation plan set.</p></li></ul><h4><strong>C. Strategic Visualizations</strong></h4><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Portfolio Composition (Pie/Donut)</strong>:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><code>By Lifecycle Phase</code>: 🛒 Pending vs 🏗️ Active vs 🏡 For Sale vs 🏘️ Rental.</p></li><li><p><code>By Company</code>: Exposure per internal entity.</p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Leverage &amp; Equity Heatmap (Stacked Bar)</strong>:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>X-axis: Project Address.</p></li><li><p>Y-axis: Total Value ($).</p></li><li><p>Stacks: [Mortgage] | [Investor Principal] | [Investor Accrued] | [Equity Gap].</p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Note Maturity Timeline (Timeline/Gantt)</strong>:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>A horizontal scroll showing upcoming expirations and total capital due at each "spike" (maturity date).</p></li></ul></li></ul><h4><strong>D. Global Filters</strong></h4><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Company Selector</strong>: View metrics for one or all internal companies.</p></li><li><p><strong>Lender/Contractor Filter</strong>: Identify concentration risk (e.g., "What happens if Lender X stops funding?").</p></li><li><p><strong>Date Range</strong>: Historical vs Projected views.</p></li></ul><h3><strong>5.2 Project Board (Consolidated View)</strong></h3><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Tabs/Phases</strong>: 🛒 Pending Purchases, 🏗️ Active Construction, 🏡 For Sale, 🏠 Pending Sales, 🏘️ Rental Properties, ✅ Sold Properties.</p></li><li><p><strong>Features</strong>:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Drag-and-Drop</strong>: Movement between phases automatically updates project status.</p></li><li><p><strong>Table Columns</strong>: Address, Owner (Color Chip), Lender, ARV, Mortgage, <strong>Investor Total</strong>, <strong>Equity</strong>, <strong>Leverage %</strong>, Status.</p></li><li><p><strong>Calculated Columns</strong>:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><code>Mortgage Payments to Date</code>: <code>Mortgage Balance * (0.08 / 12) * Months Since Closing</code>.</p></li><li><p><code>Closing Costs</code>: <code>ARV * 0.06</code>.</p></li><li><p><code>Current Equity</code>: <code>ARV - Mortgage Balance - Mortgage Payments to Date - Closing Costs - Investor Total</code>.</p></li></ul></li><li><p>Search &amp; Multi-column Sort.</p></li><li><p>Conditional Formatting: Red/Yellow/Green for Leverage % and Equity.</p></li><li><p><strong>Action Buttons</strong>: "Add Project", "Export CSV".</p></li><li><p><strong>Interaction</strong>: Clicking a row opens a <strong>Slide-over (Right)</strong> for editing and viewing detailed investor allocations.</p></li></ul></li></ul><h3><strong>5.3 Investors</strong></h3><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Table Columns</strong>: Name, Email, Total Invested, Projects Count, Next Maturity Date.</p></li><li><p><strong>Form Fields</strong> (per Project Request): Company Name (dropdown), Source (Cash, IRA, Trust, Other), Type (Monthly, Compounded, Profit Split), Payment Term (Monthly, Quarterly, Annually, Maturity), Email, Note Expiration.</p></li><li><p><strong>Interaction</strong>: Row click opens <strong>Slide-over</strong> with investor profile, allocations, and transaction history.</p></li></ul><h3><strong>5.4 Financial Reports</strong></h3><h4><strong>Monthly Distributions</strong></h4><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Focus</strong>: Only "Monthly" investment types.</p></li><li><p><strong>Table Columns</strong>: Company, Investor, Property, Type, Amount, Rate, <strong>Accrued Interest</strong>, <strong>Total Payout Due</strong>, Status (Paid/Pending), Date.</p></li><li><p><strong>Accrual Reset</strong>: Marking as "Paid" resets that record's accrued interest to $0 for the following month.</p></li></ul><h4><strong>Note Expirations (List + Calendar)</strong></h4><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Visual Indicators</strong>:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>🔴 <strong>Red</strong>: &lt; 30 days remaining.</p></li><li><p>🟡 <strong>Yellow</strong>: &lt; 60 days remaining.</p></li><li><p>🟢 <strong>Green</strong>: &gt; 60 days remaining.</p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Filter</strong>: Quick view for "Upcoming Maturities (60 Days)".</p></li></ul><h4><strong>Newsletter Tracker</strong></h4><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Logic</strong>: One row per project allocation (multi-property support).</p></li><li><p><strong>Action</strong>: "Export for Mailchimp" (CSV/Excel) including Name, Email, Property, Company.</p></li></ul><h3><strong>5.5 Sold Property Workflow (Action Modal)</strong></h3><p>Triggered when a project is marked as "Sold".</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Interface</strong>: Table showing Investor Name, Original Investment, Accrued Interest, and Total Due.</p></li><li><p><strong>Options per Investor</strong>:</p><ol class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Full Distribution</strong>: Record payout and remove funds from project.</p></li><li><p><strong>Full Reallocation</strong>: Select target project from dropdown and move total balance.</p></li><li><p><strong>Partial Distribution</strong>: Custom split between payout and reallocation.</p></li></ol></li><li><p><strong>Audit Trail</strong>: System maintains a backend history of the transaction (Original Project, Target Project, Amounts, Timestamp).</p></li></ul><hr><h2><strong>6. API Endpoints</strong></h2><h3><strong>Auth</strong></h3><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><code>POST /api/auth/login</code></p></li><li><p><code>POST /api/auth/logout</code></p></li><li><p><code>GET /api/auth/me</code></p></li></ul><h3><strong>Entities</strong></h3><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><code>GET/POST/PATCH /api/projects</code> (Includes filtered views for phases)</p></li><li><p><code>GET/POST/PATCH /api/investors</code></p></li><li><p><code>GET/POST/PATCH /api/allocations</code></p></li><li><p><code>GET/POST/PATCH /api/companies</code>, <code>/api/lenders</code>, <code>/api/config/...</code></p></li></ul><h3><strong>Operations</strong></h3><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><code>GET /api/dashboard/metrics</code> (Scorecards + Chart data)</p></li><li><p><code>POST /api/projects/:id/sold-payout</code> (Executes distribution/reallocation logic)</p></li><li><p><code>GET /api/reports/monthly-payouts</code></p></li><li><p><code>POST /api/accruals/process-payout</code> (Resets accrual for an allocation)</p></li></ul><hr><h2><strong>7. Business Logic &amp; Automations</strong></h2><ol class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Daily Accrual Engine</strong>: A cron job/server task calculates <code>Principal * (Rate/100) / 365</code> daily for every active allocation and adds it to the <code>AccrualRecords</code>.</p></li><li><p><strong>Equity Formula</strong>: <code>Equity = ARV - MortgageBalance - EstimatedClosingCosts(6% of ARV) - TotalInvestorCapital - AccruedInterest</code>.</p></li><li><p><strong>Leverage Formula</strong>: <code>Leverage % = (Mortgage + InvestorTotal) / ARV</code>.</p></li><li><p><strong>Newsletter Logic</strong>: Join <code>Investors</code> with <code>Allocations</code> and <code>Projects</code> to generate a list of unique Investor-Email-Project combinations.</p></li></ol><hr><h2><strong>8. Tech Stack</strong></h2><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Frontend</strong>: Next.js (App Router), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn/UI, Lucide Icons, Chartjs (for Dashboard).</p></li><li><p><strong>Backend</strong>: Next.js API Routes (Node.js), Prisma ORM.</p></li><li><p><strong>Database</strong>: PostgreSQL (Managed).</p></li><li><p><strong>State Management</strong>: React Query (for server state), Zustand/Redux (for UI state).</p></li></ul><p></p><hr><h2>9. Future Phases &amp; Planned Extensions (Post–Phase 1)</h2><p>Phase 1 intentionally delivers a strong internal admin foundation. The architecture must explicitly support the following future expansions without requiring major refactors.</p><hr><h3>9.1 Investor Portal (External User Access)</h3><p><strong>Goal</strong><br>Provide investors with secure, self-service access to their investments, statements, and documents, reducing manual communication and reliance on AppFolio.</p><p><strong>Key Capabilities</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Secure investor authentication (separate role from internal users)</p></li><li><p>Investor dashboard showing:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Total invested amount</p></li><li><p>Accrued interest</p></li><li><p>Active vs closed investments</p></li><li><p>Upcoming note maturities</p></li></ul></li><li><p>Per-project investment breakdown</p></li><li><p>Monthly statements:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Web view</p></li><li><p>PDF download</p></li></ul></li><li><p>Document center:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Investment agreements</p></li><li><p>Statements</p></li><li><p>Project-specific files</p></li></ul></li><li><p>Newsletter archive (read-only)</p></li><li><p>Mobile-friendly access</p></li></ul><p><strong>Technical Notes</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Reuse existing data model (investors, allocations, accruals)</p></li><li><p>Role-based access control must support strict data isolation</p></li><li><p>Statement generation logic should reuse reporting services</p></li><li><p>Auth flow must be extensible (email/password initially, SSO later optional)</p></li></ul><hr><h3>9.2 CRM &amp; Task Management (Internal Team)</h3><p><strong>Goal</strong><br>Replace Asana and fragmented task tracking with an integrated CRM-style workflow tied directly to projects, investors, and internal users.</p><p><strong>Key Capabilities</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Task management:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Create, assign, and track tasks</p></li><li><p>Statuses (Pending, In Progress, Blocked, Completed)</p></li><li><p>Due dates and priority levels</p></li></ul></li><li><p>User roles:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Admins (see all tasks)</p></li><li><p>Managers (department-level visibility)</p></li><li><p>Staff (only assigned tasks)</p></li></ul></li><li><p>Task linking:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Tasks linked to projects</p></li><li><p>Tasks linked to investors</p></li></ul></li><li><p>Activity tracking:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Task history</p></li><li><p>Status changes</p></li></ul></li><li><p>Optional future notifications:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>In-app</p></li><li><p>Email (Phase 3+)</p></li></ul></li></ul><p><strong>Technical Notes</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Tasks should be a standalone module, not hard-coupled to projects</p></li><li><p>Permissions must be enforced at query level</p></li><li><p>Design data model to support future reporting (task completion rates, bottlenecks)</p></li></ul><hr><h3>9.3 Notifications &amp; Alerts (Optional Expansion)</h3><p><strong>Potential Triggers</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Note expiration approaching</p></li><li><p>Monthly distributions due</p></li><li><p>Task overdue</p></li><li><p>Project status change</p></li><li><p>Investor reallocation completed</p></li></ul><p><strong>Channels</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>In-app notifications</p></li><li><p>Email (optional)</p></li><li><p>SMS (future)</p></li></ul><p><strong>Technical Notes</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Event-driven architecture recommended</p></li><li><p>Notification preferences per user role</p></li></ul><hr><h3>9.4 Integrations (Future Considerations)</h3><p>Potential integrations discussed conceptually:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Accounting platforms</p></li><li><p>Email marketing tools (Mailchimp)</p></li><li><p>Document storage providers</p></li><li><p>AppFolio (read-only or migration assist)</p></li></ul><p>These should be handled through a decoupled integration layer.</p><hr><h3>9.5 Architectural Requirements for Phase 1 (to Support Future Phases)</h3><p>Phase 1 implementation <strong>must</strong>:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Use role-based access throughout (no hard-coded permissions)</p></li><li><p>Keep reporting logic centralized and reusable</p></li><li><p>Avoid embedding business rules directly into UI</p></li><li><p>Use scalable relational patterns (no denormalized shortcuts)</p></li><li><p>Maintain clean separation between internal users and future external users</p></li></ul><hr><h3>9.6 Phase Strategy</h3><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Phase 1: Internal admin system (current scope)</p></li><li><p>Phase 2: Investor Portal</p></li><li><p>Phase 3: CRM + Task Management</p></li><li><p>Phase 4+: Notifications, integrations, advanced analytics</p></li></ul><p>Each phase is designed to layer cleanly on top of the previous one.</p></div>
</details>

<details class="details">
<summary>Original Project Request from Client:</summary><div data-type="detailsContent"><hr><p><strong>DATA ENTRY FORMS</strong></p><p><strong>🧾 Add Investor – Data Entry Form</strong></p><p>When selecting <strong>“Add Investor,”</strong> the form should include the following fields and actions:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Company Name</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Dropdown menu listing all active companies</p></li><li><p>Select which company the investor is investing into</p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Investor Name</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Text field for full name</p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Investment Source (“Invested How”)</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Dropdown options: <strong>Cash, IRA, Trust, Other</strong></p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Investment Type</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Dropdown options:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Monthly Interest</strong></p></li><li><p><strong>Compounded Interest</strong></p></li><li><p><strong>Profit Split</strong> (with field to enter percentage)</p></li></ul></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Investment Amount</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Numeric entry for total capital invested</p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Project Allocation</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Dropdown menu showing <strong>all active projects</strong></p></li><li><p>Ability to select <strong>one</strong> project to allocate funds should allow multi-project allocation and amounts</p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Investment Date</strong></p><ul class="tight" Reallocation Function</strong></p><p>This feature activates when a property’s status is changed to <strong>“Sold.”</strong><br>It allows the user to manage how investor funds are distributed, partially distributed, or reallocated to other active projects.</p><hr><p><strong>⚙️ Function Overview</strong></p><p>When a property is marked as <strong>Sold</strong>, the system should automatically open a <strong>Distribution &amp; Reallocation Window</strong> where all investors associated with that project appear, showing:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Investor Name</p></li><li><p>Original Investment Amount</p></li><li><p>Accrued Interest</p></li><li><p>Total Due (Principal + Interest)</p></li></ul><p>From there, the user can choose one of three options per investor.</p><hr><p><strong>🔁 Investor Options (Per Investor Row)</strong></p><ol class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Full Distribution</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Select <strong>“Distribute”</strong> and enter the <strong>payout amount</strong> (can match or differ from total due).</p></li><li><p>The system records the payment and removes that investor’s funds from the project.</p></li><li><p>Will remove the project from the monthly report &amp; distribution report if necessary</p></li><li><p>Accrued interest resets to $0 once distributed.</p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Full Reallocation</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Select <strong>“Reallocate”</strong> to move investor funds directly into a <strong>new active project</strong>.</p></li><li><p>A dropdown menu appears listing all <strong>active properties</strong>.</p></li><li><p>User selects the target project(s) and enters the reallocated amount.</p></li><li><p>The new allocation should automatically appear in that project’s investor list and update its totals and equity calculation.</p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Partial Distribution / Partial Reallocation</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Select <strong>“Split Allocation.”</strong></p></li><li><p>User can enter <strong>custom amounts</strong> to:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Distribute a portion</strong> (payout to investor), and</p></li><li><p><strong>Reallocate the remaining portion</strong> to one or more projects.</p></li></ul></li><li><p>Example: $100,000 total → $60,000 distributed, $40,000 reallocated.</p></li><li><p>Each allocation should generate its own record in the database for transparency and reporting.</p></li></ul></li></ol><hr><p><strong>🧮 System Logic &amp; Automation</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p><strong>Automatic Adjustments:</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Once a distribution or reallocation is saved, the sold property’s investor totals update to $0, and all associated records move to <strong>Closed / Archived</strong> status.</p></li><li><p>Reallocated amounts should automatically populate the target project’s <strong>Investor Totals</strong> and update that project’s <strong>Equity / Leverage</strong> position.</p></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Tracking &amp; Audit Trail: If possible behind the scenes</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Maintain a clear transaction history showing:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Investor name</p></li><li><p>Original project sold</p></li><li><p>Amount distributed</p></li><li><p>Amount reallocated</p></li><li><p>Destination project(s)</p></li><li><p>Date/time of transaction</p></li></ul></li></ul></li><li><p><strong>Optional Email Notification:</strong></p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Once reallocation or distribution is confirmed, system can send an automatic summary email to the investor confirming:</p><ul class="tight" data-tight="true"><li><p>Project sold</p></li><li><p>Amount distributed</p></li><li><p>Amount reallocated and new project details</p></li></ul></li></ul></li></ul></div>
</details>
